step: cook with sugar and fat to a set stage
text: Cream and butter are stirred into hot sugar syrup, which is cooked again to the firm-ball stage; vanilla and salt go in last (vanilla earlier would burn off, salt earlier would invert the sugar).

steps.note: Sugar and glucose are cooked first, then the cream and butter are stirred in.
The syrup is cooked until firm, and vanilla and salt are stirred in last, so the vanilla does not burn off.
